The V4044A1001 is a two-position hydronic zone valve from Resideo, the brand that carries the Honeywell Home line of residential heating controls. It pairs a motorized actuator with a 1/2-inch flare valve body to start and stop hot water flow to a single heating zone on a call from a thermostat or zone panel.

This is a diverting valve. Instead of simply opening and closing one path, it moves flow between two outlets, which is how a single circulator can serve a heating zone and an indirect water heater without a second pump.

The 1/2-inch flare connections tie the valve into the supply piping, and the V4044A1001 handles supply water at operating pressures up to 300 psi.

This is a QuickFit model: the actuator head releases from the valve body without breaking the piping connection, so a failed motor is changed out without draining the system or unsoldering anything.

The V8043 and V4043 series have been the reference zone valves in North American hydronic heating for decades, and most contractors still order them by the original Honeywell part number. The actuator head is field-replaceable, so a burned-out motor does not mean cutting the body out of the line.

The V4043A1705 is a two-position hydronic zone valve from Resideo, the brand that carries the Honeywell Home line of residential heating controls. It pairs a motorized actuator with a NPT valve body to start and stop hot water flow to a single heating zone on a call from a thermostat or zone panel.

The valve is normally closed. That is the safer default on a boiler loop feeding radiators, convectors, finned baseboard, or in-floor radiant tubing.

The NPT connections tie the valve into the supply piping, and the V4043A1705 handles supply water at operating pressures up to 300 psi.

A linear characteristic means flow tracks stem position in a straight line, which keeps a modulating loop stable instead of dumping most of its capacity in the first part of the stroke.

What a complete VC zone valve takes: a valve body, a cartridge, and an actuator, ordered separately. This listing is the valve assembly — pick the actuator that matches your control signal, whether that is two-position, floating, or modulating.
